entries.title: I Kings 20:1

entries.title: I Kings 20:4

segments: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, [that] whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put [it] in their hand, and take [it] away. {pleasant: Heb. desirable}
